description: SHA-level trailer contract for #1221. Path presence is a heuristic only. trailer_safe SHAs may receive a well-formed Ported-from trailer after semantic spot-check. do_not_trailer SHAs must remain Attention even at high path presence; do not add or reformat a trailer to silence them. Intentional skips (for example pull_request_target auto-run) belong here with a documented skip, not a trailer. This list does not expand the path whitelist.
